scope: Controlled physical replay of CEM's selected first-action prefixes on historical development states. Not protected confirmation, full-task success, or a demonstrated explanation of the protected aggregate
selection: Every new CEM-extension case, regardless of observed divergence, predicted costs or original success. No cases selected for interesting outcomes
reset: Reuse original decision_runtime.reset_initial: exact seeded task0 reset, seeded_rand_vec and original reset_warmup. Require original observation SHA plus all8-field physics SHA, bound goal and input record/DONE. Never reconstruct state from image/proprio or naively inject qpos/qvel. Freeze exact simulator/vendor versions in execution manifest
execution: Each saved selected_plan[3,20] is reshaped to15x4, denormalized exactly once by original action bounds and passed to unchanged step_multiple with repeat_actskip=False. Exactly15 elementary steps per prefix. No additional action repetitions. Reset to the same qualified initial state before each plan; repeat native as a deterministic physical control in every case
physical_parity: Repeated native must reproduce action bytes, every state/reward/done/success and endpoint observation/physics hashes exactly. Reject qualification failure; preserve logs. Do not relax tolerances after observing outcomes
forecast: To preserve the frozen H6-only intervention code, zero-pad each actual3-step prefix to6steps and run all3 model arms; score ONLY the H3 prefix endpoint. Nine single-candidate H6 forecasts/case. H6 zero-tail output is not the selected plan and is not analyzed. Tagged firstcase additionally verifies H3 byte invariance to a fixed nonzero future tail for all3 model arms on the native prefix
actual_endpoint: Capture wrapper-returned endpoint image and proprio observations; use the unchanged frozen encoders and task preprocessing to obtain actual H3 embeddings. Retain decoded physical state separately. Do not replace actual embeddings with a learned decoder's estimate
goals: Original physical goal_state and original encoded goal from bound input. Actual and predicted latent goal costs use visual embedding MSE plus0.1*proprio MSE. Physical end-effector distance uses first3 state coordinates versus first3 goal_state coordinates exactly as original decision_runtime
primary_contrasts: terminal physical end-effector distance: edited-plan minus native-plan
actual latent goal cost: edited-plan minus native-plan
H3 forecast MSE on the SAME native-chosen prefix: edited-model minus native-model
primary_family: Two tasks times two edit arms times three metrics =12 prespecified paired-context contrasts; n28/task. Negative differences mean lower distance/error, not established full-task success
secondary: Complete3model-by3prefix forecast error/cost grid; predicted versus actual goal-preference differences for each edited/native plan pair; preference-reversal counts; initial distance, every physical state/reward/done and prefix_success. Prefix_success is not a new100-step task-success measurement. No candidate/model/step pseudoreplication
preference_reversal: For model armL and selected plans aL/aN: model_cost_L(aL)-model_cost_L(aN)<0 while actual_encoded_goal_cost(aL)-actual_encoded_goal_cost(aN)>0. Record ties separately, no threshold tuning. This is horizon3 preference disagreement; CEM optimized horizon6, so it does not by itself prove exploitation of its full planning objective
intervals: Paired-context percentile95 and Bonferroni family12 intervals, quantiles0.05/24 and1-0.05/24. Same task-specific weights across model/plan/metric cells; descriptive scenario SE for plots. Full cohort required for final aggregate
receiving_gate: Qualify deterministic reset and repeated native prefix on first registeredcase; inspect identity/timing only before remainingcases. One bounded engineering repair for a source/config error; no scientific gate waiver or outcome-conditioned omissions
budget: Existing65USD total and14USD/hour aggregate remain binding; incremental physical replay ceiling5USD incl setup/network/compute. Reuse existing qualified hosts, no new rental for this test. Setup qualification at most15minutes, measured runtime must fit remaining budget
deadline: 2026-09-13T22:00Z scientific hardstop, then verified archive/release. No idle host retention beyond active assigned work
preservation: Source/protocol/input/reset/goal/CEM-parent/fit/checkpoint hashes, full actual15step physical sequences and endpoint observations, actions and model-by-plan scalar metrics, parities, DONE and download-SHA cloudreceipt. All bulk observations stay cloud-first, never fill laptop disk
interpretation: Can causally measure effects of selected action prefixes on matched development states and editing forecasts on identical actions. Cannot recover missing protected-rollout candidate traces, identify a unique dormant circuit or prove improved long-horizon control
